sources.entry: Vagrant Manager - Manage your vagrant machines in one place with Vagrant Manager for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Vagrant Manager is a macOS status bar app for viewing and managing all of your Vagrant machines from one place.
summary.what_it_does: The app runs as an OS X status bar menu item and detects most Vagrant machines automatically. Machines that are not detected can be added manually as bookmarks by specifying the path to a Vagrantfile. Bookmarks keep a machine listed even after it is destroyed. It executes VBoxManage and vagrant commands, and prlctl if Parallels is used, so those must be on the PATH. The README says machines must already be initialized with vagrant init to be detected. A DMG distribution can be built with appdmg. The README also links to a Windows version of the project.
use_cases: manage multiple vagrant virtual machines from a menu bar
view status of local vagrant boxes on a mac
bookmark vagrant machines so they persist after destroy
control VirtualBox or Parallels vagrant VMs from one place
how_to_run: Download Vagrant Manager from the GitHub Releases Page
Install VirtualBox and Vagrant, and ensure VBoxManage and vagrant are in your PATH
Run vagrant init on any machine you want detected
Add bookmarks manually for machines that are not detected
stack: Objective-C or Swift (macOS app, not specified in README)
notable: Lives in the macOS status bar for quick access to all Vagrant machines
Auto-detects most Vagrant machines; manual bookmarks for the rest
Bookmarks keep machines listed after they are destroyed
Supports Parallels through prlctl in addition to VirtualBox
A Windows version exists as a separate project
caveats: Requires OS X 10.8 Mountain Lion or higher
Machines must already be initialized with vagrant init to be detected
Requires VirtualBox and Vagrant installed and on PATH
